evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies getrawtransaction and REST endpoints in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp.
rationale: Corrects a misleading RPC failure mode where disk I/O errors or index corruption caused getrawtransaction and REST endpoints to report confirmed transactions as missing. Downstream applications rely on RPC correctness, and distinguishing internal storage errors from non-existent transactions prevents callers from taking incorrect actions based on false negative responses.
